Resolve DOIs to OpenAlex IDs offline

Source: R/doi_to_id.R
doi_to_id.Rd

Looks DOIs up in the index built by build_doi_index(). DOIs may be given with or without a resolver prefix; all of these resolve identically:

Usage

doi_to_id(
  doi,
  root_dir = NULL,
  index_file = NULL,
  data_set = "works",
  verbose = TRUE
)

Arguments

doi

Character vector of DOIs.

root_dir

Root directory containing a parquet/ subdirectory, or the parquet directory itself.

index_file

Explicit path to a *_doi_idx.parquet. Overrides root_dir.

data_set

Dataset name used to locate the index under root_dir.

verbose

Print progress.

Value

A data frame with one row per input, in input order:

doi_input

The string as supplied

doi

Its normalised key

id

The OpenAlex ID in long form, or NA if unresolved

A data frame rather than a bare vector, because the caller needs to know which inputs failed to resolve.
